from manim import *

class TeachingScene(Scene):
    def setup_layout(self, title_text, lecture_lines):
        # BASE
        self.camera.background_color = "#000000"
        self.title = Text(title_text, font_size=28, color=WHITE).to_edge(UP)
        self.add(self.title)

        # Left-side lecture content (bullets with "-")
        lecture_texts = [Text(line, font_size=22, color=WHITE) for line in lecture_lines]
        self.lecture = VGroup(*lecture_texts).arrange(DOWN, aligned_edge=LEFT).scale(0.8)
        self.lecture.to_edge(LEFT, buff=0.2)
        self.add(self.lecture)

        # Define fine-grained animation grid (4x4 grid on right side)
        self.grid = {}
        rows = ["A", "B", "C", "D", "E", "F"]  # Top to bottom
        cols = ["1", "2", "3", "4", "5", "6"]  # Left to right

        for i, row in enumerate(rows):
            for j, col in enumerate(cols):
                x = 0.5 + j * 1
                y = 2.2 - i * 1
                self.grid[f"{row}{col}"] = np.array([x, y, 0])

    def place_at_grid(self, mobject, grid_pos, scale_factor=1.0):
        mobject.scale(scale_factor)
        mobject.move_to(self.grid[grid_pos])
        return mobject

    def place_in_area(self, mobject, top_left, bottom_right, scale_factor=1.0):
        tl_pos = self.grid[top_left]
        br_pos = self.grid[bottom_right]
        
        # Calculate center of the area
        center_x = (tl_pos[0] + br_pos[0]) / 2
        center_y = (tl_pos[1] + br_pos[1]) / 2
        center = np.array([center_x, center_y, 0])
        
        mobject.scale(scale_factor)
        mobject.move_to(center)
        return mobject

        basis_v1 = Vector([1, 0.5], color=YELLOW)
        basis_v2 = Vector([-0.5, 1], color=BLUE)

        self.play(GrowArrow(basis_v1), GrowArrow(basis_v2), FadeIn(vector_icon))
        self.wait(1)

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 3 ===
        self.play(self.lecture[2].animate.set_color(GREEN))
        target_b = Vector([0.5, 1.5], color=GREEN)
        self.place_at_grid(target_b, 'B5', scale_factor=1.2)

        self.wait(1)

outline.topic: The Geometric Intuition of Linear Systems: Spaces and Inverses

sections.title: Visualizing Linear Systems (1 min)
sections.content: Introduce linear systems as transformations. A system Ax = b represents the search for an input vector 'x' that maps to a target vector 'b'. Visualize columns of 'A' as basis vectors that define the destination grid.
sections.example: Imagine a robot arm (the matrix A) moving in 2D space. The system solves where to set the joint angles (x) to place the gripper at a target coordinate (b).

sections.title: Column Space: The Reachable World (1 min)
sections.content: Define Column Space as the span of the matrix columns—the set of all possible outcomes. If the columns are linearly independent, they span the full space. If they are dependent, the reach 'collapses' into a line or a point.
sections.example: A 2D drone can fly anywhere (full column space). If its motors are locked on a specific axis, it can only move along a line (a lower-dimensional column space).

sections.title: Null Space: The 'Ghost' Inputs (1 min)
sections.content: Define Null Space as the set of non-zero inputs 'x' that map to the origin. These represent ambiguity or loss of information during the transformation.
sections.example: A 3D scanner (Matrix A) takes a 3D object and projects it into a 2D image. The 'Null Space' is the line of sight along which depth is lost; any object placed on that line results in the same 2D shadow.

sections.title: Inverse Matrices: The Rewind Button (1 min)
sections.content: Explain the inverse matrix A⁻¹ as a 'reversal' operation. This only exists if the mapping is bijective (non-zero determinant). Geometrically, this means we can uniquely 'undo' the transformation to return to the original input.
sections.example: A video compressor (A) makes a file smaller (mapping to a smaller space). The inverse (A⁻¹) is the decompressor that reconstructs the original video from the compressed data.

sections.title: Synthesis & Summary (1 min)
sections.content: Connect the dots: If the Null Space contains only zero, the system is invertible. If the Column Space doesn't cover the whole target space, the system may have no solution (b is unreachable) or infinitely many (if b is in the column space).
sections.example: A summary animation showing a transformation (A) followed by its inverse (A⁻¹) returning to the start, highlighting that if there is a 'Null Space', the inverse path cannot be uniquely traced back.

Load and place the referenced files in the scene where the storyboard calls for them, while preserving the existing lecture-line alignment and layout constraints. Asset-tagged animations: ['Display a forward linear transformation on a [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/grid.svg].', 'Highlight the return to original [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/grid.svg] state.']
issues.resolution_note: Integrated /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/grid.svg into the scene animations.

issues.description: [VideoCritic][section_1] Problem: The target_b vector is visually isolated and lacks a proximity label, creating an unclear spatial relationship in the grid. Fix: Line 72: self.place_at_grid(target_b, 'B5', scale_factor=1.2); self.add_label(target_b, 'b', 'B6', scale_factor=0.8) (line=72, object=target_b)
issues.resolution_note: Added label for target vector b and adjusted positioning.

issues.description: [VideoCritic][section_1] Problem: The basis_group vectors occupy the center-left area, causing them to conflict with the left-aligned lecture text area. Fix: Line 57: self.place_in_area(basis_group, 'C3', 'E4', scale_factor=0.9) (line=57, object=basis_group)
issues.resolution_note: Adjusted basis_group positioning to avoid conflict with lecture text.

issues.description: [VideoCritic][section_1] Problem: The grid visual background elements (A1-F6) are too widely spaced, causing the lecture text to appear cramped on the left. Fix: Line 57: self.place_in_area(grid_points, 'A4', 'F6', scale_factor=0.7) (line=57, object=basis_group)
issues.resolution_note: Refined grid placement to prevent lecture text crowding.

issues.description: [VideoCritic][section_2] Problem: col1 and col2 are both placed at B2, causing a direct visual overlap and obstruction of the vectors. Fix: Line 61: self.place_at_grid(col1, 'B2', scale_factor=0.6); Line 62: self.place_at_grid(col2, 'B3', scale_factor=0.6) (line=61, object=col1, col2)
issues.resolution_note: Resolved: Placed col1 at B2 and col2 at B3 with scale 0.6.

issues.description: [VideoCritic][section_2] Problem: The plane object occupies the area B2-D4, which is currently obstructed by the overlapping column vectors at B2/B3. Fix: Line 67: self.place_in_area(plane, 'C4', 'E6', scale_factor=0.8) (line=67, object=plane)
issues.resolution_note: Resolved: Moved plane to C4-E6 area.

issues.description: [VideoCritic][section_2] Problem: The line object at E3 is too close to the shifted plane area, potentially creating visual clutter. Fix: Line 73: self.place_at_grid(line, 'F3', scale_factor=0.7) (line=73, object=line)
issues.resolution_note: Resolved: Moved final collapse line to F3.

issues.description: [VideoCritic][section_3] Problem: The object 'axes' placed at C3 creates visual tension with the lecture text, as it spans too centrally and obscures the relationship between the text and the graphic. Fix: self.place_in_area(axes, 'B3', 'E5', scale_factor=0.9) (line=1, object=axes)
issues.resolution_note: Fixed axes positioning using place_in_area.

issues.description: [VideoCritic][section_3] Problem: The 'Null Space' label is currently positioned too far from the origin of the line, creating proximity issues and poor readability. Fix: self.place_at_grid(label, 'D5', scale_factor=0.7) (line=2, object=Null Space label)
issues.resolution_note: Fixed label positioning using place_at_grid.

issues.description: [VideoCritic][section_3] Problem: The vector 'x' at C3 is prone to being obscured by the intersection of the grid coordinates during complex animations. Fix: self.place_at_grid(x, 'B4', scale_factor=0.8) (line=3, object=vector x)
issues.resolution_note: Fixed vector x positioning using place_at_grid.

issues.description: [VideoCritic][section_4] Problem: The grid visualization is too large, crowding the screen and potentially conflicting with future lecture text additions. Fix: self.place_in_area(grid_visual, 'B3', 'F6', scale_factor=0.6) (line=8, object=grid_visual)
issues.resolution_note: Fixed grid visualization size and area using B3-F6 and scale factor 0.6.

issues.description: [VideoCritic][section_4] Problem: The moving yellow dot animation overlaps with the grid boundary lines, making the transformation process difficult to track. Fix: self.place_at_grid(yellow_dot, 'D4', scale_factor=0.5) (line=1, object=yellow_dot)
issues.resolution_note: Fixed dot position to D4.

issues.description: [VideoCritic][section_4] Problem: The lecture text is left-aligned while the grid occupies the entire right side, creating a significant imbalance in visual negative space. Fix: self.place_in_area(lecture_text, 'A1', 'A3', scale_factor=0.9) (line=2, object=lecture_text)
